title: Create migrations for 17 character-related tables
acceptance_criteria: Migration file(s) create all 17 character tables from db/schema.rb
All columns match db/schema.rb types: string, integer, float, text, boolean, datetime
Boolean columns with default: false where specified (disabled fields)
Foreign key columns use integer type with index: true
Tables use t.timestamps instead of separate created_at/updated_at columns
